findings.location: Paragraph beginning «Den mest dramatiske åpenbaringen av paktskjærlighet»; quotation, Jesaja 55:6–7
findings.source_quote: “and let him return unto the LORD, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.”
